Navigate to https://www.bcc.kz/kz/ then Use the normal visual page and a pointer.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, send or submit anything, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Use the normal visual page.
Identify this button with a single pointer click: Поиск.
The harness records the click and suppresses activation.

summary:
The test assumed the search button could be clicked while the page was in a first-visit cookie-consent state. The consent overlay was still active, and clearing it would have changed the fixture settings prohibited by the objective.
Start this test with cookie consent already configured, or allow the test to dismiss the consent notice before clicking the search button.
one_liner: The run started with a cookie-consent overlay active, so the required search-button interaction could not be completed under the no-settings-change rule.
reason: The cookie-consent overlay covers the visible search button, and dismissing it would change fixture settings.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent used the specified visible search control at step 0-2. It did not cause the blocking consent state. The failure comes from an incompatible test setup: the objective requires a click behind an active overlay while also forbidding the only allowed visible way to remove that overlay.
